summary: Hash matches. Governing-input and Appendix B hashes, the seed-20261110 partition (reproduced: 549 runs, 33.4%), Appendix A counts and the Zenodo pins all verify. The registry and run folders hold no result on any new arm or target, and no EA or gas label file is on disk. No blocking finding in this lens. Eleven should_fix items need binding rulings: design B trains H4 on a scored block against campaign rule 1 and changes the registered TON analysis; both protected-row loaders skip the claim when root= is passed; holdout censoring counts were computed and printed; Test-B cannot be claimed after M3/test as coded; licence rows are missing; the letter group is unverified as an area.
